t: If the eccentricity of a hyperbola is 5/3, then the eccentricity of its conjugate hyperbola is

t: If two points P, Q on the hyperbola x²/a²−y²/b²=1, whose center is C be such that CP is perpendicular to CQ and a<b, then the value of 1/CP²+1/CQ²is

t: Find the equation of the locus of all points such that the difference of their distances from (4,0) and (−4,0) is always equal to 2.
s:
Given
|PS₁−PS₂|=2
⇒2a=2
⇒a=1
also distance between the focii 2ae=8
⇒e=4
Now b²=a²(e²−1)
⇒  b²=15
equation of hyperbola is
x²/1−y²/15=1
Alternate Solution
Let S₁(4,0) and S₂(−4,0) be the two given points.
Let P(x, y) be any point on the locus.
By def., |PS₁|−|PS₂|=2
⇒ √((x−4)²+(y−0)²)−√((x+4)²+(y−0)²)=2
⇒ √((x−4)²+y²)=2+√((x+4)²+y²)
Squaring, (x−4)²+y²=4+4√((x+4)²+y²)+(x+4)²+y²
⇒ x²−8x+16+y²=4+4√((x+4)²+y²)+x²+8x+16+y²
⇒ 4√((x+4)²+y²)=−16x−4
⇒ √((x+4)²+y²)=−4x−1
Again squaring,
(x+4)²+y²=(−4x−1)²
⇒ x²+8x+16+y²=16x²+8x+1
⇒ 15x²−y²=15
⇒ x²/1−y²/15=1,
which is the required equation of the locus. ​

t: The equation of the latusrectum of the hyperbola (10x - 5)2 + (10y - 2)2 = 9(3x + 4y - 7)2 is
s:
The given equation can be written as
(10x−5)²+(10y−2)²=9{(3x+4y−7)/(√(3²+4²))}²×25
⇒ (2x−1)²+(2y−2/5)²=9{(3x+4y−7)/(√(3²+4²))}²
⇒ 4(x−1/2)²+4(y−1/5)²=9{(3x+4y−7)/(√(3²+4²))}²
⇒ (x−1/2)²+(y−1/5)²=9/4{(3x+4y−7)/(√(3²+4²))}²
This is of the form
(x−α)²+(y−β)²=e²{(3x+4y−7)/(√(3²+4²))}²
Such that e²=9/4
ie., e=3/2(>1)
Hence this equation represents the equation of a hyperbola whose focus is (α, β) i.e., (1/2, 1/5) and directrix is 3x + 4y - 7 = 0.
Since the latusrectum passes through the focus and is parallel to the directrix, hence its equation is y−1/5=m(x−1/2)
where m=−3/4
Thus, the required equation of the latusrectum is y−1/5=−3/4(x−1/2)

t: Let C₁ be the graph of xy=1 and the reflection of C₁ in the line y=2x is C₂. If the equation of C₂ is expressed as 12x²+bxy+cy²+d=0, then the value of (b+c+d) is equal to
s:
Any point on the hyperbola xy=1 is (t,1/t)
Now, the image of (t,1/t) by the line mirror y=2x is
(x−t)/2=(y−1/t)/(−1)=−2((2t−1/t)/5)
⇒5x=4/t−3t and 5y=4t+3/t
Now eliminating t from above two equations we get,
12x²−12y²−7xy+25=0
∴b+c+d=6
